title: Floors & Sequences: Ordinal Numerals (-дугаар/-дүгээр, -дахь/-дэх)
primaryPurpose: Introduce ordinal numeral derivation using suffixes -дугаар/-дүгээр and -дахь/-дэх for floor levels, sequential rankings, and retail departments.
communicativeOutcome: Ask and explain which floor a retail department or store is located on (e.g. 'Гуравдугаар давхарт', 'Тав дахь давхар луу гараарай').
readingObjective: Read floor directories of major department stores (State Department Store, Shangri-La Mall).
listeningObjective: Identify floor numbers and store names from mall directory help desk speech.
writingObjective: Write 3 sentences detailing which products are found on specific floors.
spokenProductionObjective: Direct a shopper: 'Эмэгтэй хувцасны тасаг хоёрдугаар давхарт байгаа'.
pragmaticTarget: Using formal ordinals (-дугаар) for formal directories and colloquial ordinals (-дахь) for speech.
reviewReason: Transforms cardinal roots into ordinal markers for hierarchical physical navigation.
audioPurpose: Model vowel harmony alternation between back (-дугаар, -дахь) and front (-дүгээр, -дэх) suffixes.
successCriteria: Selects appropriate ordinal suffix according to root vowel harmony and stylistic register
Accurately constructs locative phrases specifying floor locations
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Номын дэлгүүр зургаадугаар давхарт байна' accurately matching phonology.

title: Ikh Delguur & Modern Malls: Department Store Vocabulary
primaryPurpose: Introduce specific vocabulary for shopping mall sections (гоо сайхан, цахилгаан бараа, бэлэг дурсгал, цахилгаан шат, урсдаг шат).
communicativeOutcome: Identify mall departments, locate escalators/elevators, and ask for specific product categories.
readingObjective: Read hanging overhead mall signs directing foot traffic to escalators and restrooms.
listeningObjective: Understand mall directory audio kiosk prompts and category selections.
writingObjective: Create a shopping checklist organized by department store floor.
spokenProductionObjective: Ask a store clerk: 'Цахилгаан барааны тасаг хэддүгээр давхарт байдаг вэ?'.
pragmaticTarget: Navigating multi-story shopping centers independently and efficiently.
reviewReason: Expands basic convenience store shopping to multi-department commercial complexes.
audioPurpose: Pronounce compound departmental terms clearly.
successCriteria: Identifies key retail sections: гэр ахуйн бараа (home goods), бэлэг дурсгал (souvenirs), хүнс (groceries)
Distinguishes урсдаг шат (escalator) from цахилгаан шат (elevator)
masteryEvidence: Accurately categorizes 8 everyday items into their corresponding department store floors.

title: At the Information Desk: Inquiring About Brands & Services
primaryPurpose: Develop spoken interaction skills with shopping mall information desk staff, inquiring about specific boutiques, lost property, and wheelchair access.
communicativeOutcome: Ask information desk staff where a specific brand is sold, locate customer service, and ask about gift wrapping.
listeningObjective: Follow information officer's instructions: 'Та урсдаг шатаар гуравдугаар давхарт гараад зүүн тийш эргээрэй'.
spokenProductionObjective: Ask information clerk: 'Уучлаарай, монгол бэлэг дурсгалын тасаг аль давхарт байдаг вэ?'.
pragmaticTarget: Using respectful conversational openers ('Танаас нэг зүйл лавлаж болох уу?').
reviewReason: Builds on service counter inquiry routines established in A1.
audioPurpose: Model polite, professional concierge responses in a busy mall lobby.
successCriteria: Inquires about store location using ordinal numbers and polite phrasing
Comprehends spoken directions combining floor number, escalator, and cardinal turns
masteryEvidence: Successfully completes simulated concierge dialogue finding the cashmere boutique.

title: Acoustic Lab: Mall Promotional Announcements & Store Hours
primaryPurpose: Develop acoustic listening comprehension of mall-wide promotional announcements (хямдрал, урамшуулал), flash sales, and closing announcements.
communicativeOutcome: Extract discount percentages, participating store departments, and evening closing times from public address audio.

spokenProductionObjective: Inform shopping companion of closing time: 'Дэлгүүр 30 минутын дараа хаагдах гэж байна'.
pragmaticTarget: Parsing recorded announcements with musical jingles and customer background noise.
reviewReason: Advances from market stall vendor calls to polished commercial store announcements.
audioPurpose: Authentic audio with mall background music, cashier beeps, and echoing loudspeaker voice.
successCriteria: Extracts discount percentages (хорин хувь, тавин хувь) accurately from audio
Identifies floor number and department hosting the promotional event
masteryEvidence: Fills in promotional summary table correctly for 3 distinct mall broadcast announcements.

title: Shopping Guide: Writing Floor Directory Guides & Store Notes
primaryPurpose: Synthesize ordinal numerals, departmental vocabulary, and spatial postpositions in a written shopping guide and personal errand plan.
communicativeOutcome: Draft a written floor-by-floor shopping guide advising a visitor where to buy gifts, electronics, and clothing.

Correctly spells specialized retail categories: бэлэг дурсгал, гоо сайхан, цахилгаан бараа
masteryEvidence: Drafts '1-р давхарт: супермаркет ба эмийн сан; 2-р давхарт: эмэгтэй бэлэн хувцас...' correctly.

title: Cotton, Wool & Silk: Garment Fabrics & Fitting Rooms
primaryPurpose: Introduce vocabulary for clothing materials (хөвөн даавуу, ноос, ноолуур, торго), international size conversions, and fitting room amenities (өлгүүр, толь).
communicativeOutcome: Ask for clothing sizes (S, M, L or European sizes), identify textile composition, and locate fitting rooms.
readingObjective: Read clothing care labels specifying fabric percentages (100% даавуу) and washing icons.
listeningObjective: Understand sales assistant explaining size numbering differences (Asian vs European).
writingObjective: List personal clothing measurements and fabric preferences in Cyrillic.
spokenProductionObjective: Ask sales clerk: 'Энэ цамцнаас M хэмжээтэй нь байна уу? Би өмсөж үзэж болох уу?'.
pragmaticTarget: Checking fabric care requirements before committing to a purchase.
reviewReason: Deepens basic garment naming from A1 into textile science and sizing systems.
audioPurpose: Pronounce textile materials and size terms clearly.
successCriteria: Identifies key fabrics: даавуу (cotton), ноос (wool), ноолуур (cashmere), торго (silk)
Asks politely to use the fitting room (хувцас солих өрөө)
masteryEvidence: Correctly matches 6 fabric descriptions with their thermal and aesthetic properties.

title: Too Tight or Just Right: Clothing Fit & Proportion Adjectives
primaryPurpose: Introduce qualitative adjectives for garment fit, length, and tightness (бариу, сул, урт, богино, таарах) and the degree adverb хэт (too / excessively).
communicativeOutcome: Describe how clothing fits the body and state whether an item is too tight, loose, long, or short.
readingObjective: Read garment fit advice columns discussing contemporary trends (сул загвар / oversized).
listeningObjective: Recognize fit descriptors when shoppers discuss trying on garments.
writingObjective: Write 3 sentences evaluating garment dimensions using fit adjectives and 'хэт' (too).
spokenProductionObjective: State fit assessment: 'Энэ өмд надад хэтэрхий бариу байна, арай сул нь байна уу?'.
pragmaticTarget: Expressing dissatisfaction with fit politely without criticizing garment quality.
reviewReason: Expands basic size adjectives (том, жижиг) to nuanced garment fitting terminology.
audioPurpose: Model emphatic pitch accent on degree modifiers (хэт, арай, яг).
successCriteria: Differentiates бариу (tight) from сул (loose/baggy) and богино (short) from урт (long)
Uses verb таарах (to fit/suit) correctly with dative subject: 'Надад яг таарч байна'
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Энэ цамц мөрөөрөө бариу боловч ханцуй нь урт байна' accurately.

title: Acoustic Lab: Fitting Room Conversations & Size Inquiries
primaryPurpose: Develop acoustic listening comprehension of spontaneous shopper-clerk dialogues through fitting room curtains and mirrors.
communicativeOutcome: Understand sales assistants offering alternative sizes, colorways, or fits while trying on clothes.
listeningObjective: Identify whether shopper accepts the tried garment or requests a different size/color from audio clips.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain to a friend what the sales clerk suggested from behind the curtain.

reviewReason: Tests listening acuity in conversational retail settings.
audioPurpose: Deliver authentic fitting room dialogue with acoustic curtain dampening and clothing hanger clatter.
successCriteria: Identifies whether garment is described as too tight, too loose, or ideal fit
Extracts requested replacement size (e.g. 'Нэг размер том') correctly
masteryEvidence: Scores 100% on 4 fitting room interaction comprehension audio items.

title: In the Boutique: Requesting Different Sizes & Colors
primaryPurpose: Master spoken interaction in a clothing boutique: asking to try on garments, requesting a different size or shade, and asking for a mirror assessment.
communicativeOutcome: Engage with a boutique clerk to exchange sizes, ask for a matching color, and make a purchasing decision.
listeningObjective: Understand sales clerk offering opinions: 'Энэ өнгө танд их сайхан зохиж байна'.
spokenProductionObjective: Request another size: 'Уучлаарай, энэ жаахан бариу байна. Үүнээс нэг размер томыг авчирч өгөөч?'.
pragmaticTarget: Using constructive polite requests while evaluating clothing in front of a mirror.
reviewReason: Utilizes polite request imperatives (-аач/-ээч) during retail service requests.
audioPurpose: Provide natural native speaker boutique dialogue with realistic compliments and advice.
successCriteria: Conducts a complete 5-turn exchange trying on an item, requesting an adjustment, and deciding to purchase
Uses verb зохих (to suit/flatter) accurately: 'Танд сайхан зохиж байна'
masteryEvidence: Executes full unscripted fitting room roleplay without communication breakdown.

title: Online Boutique Review: Garment Fit & Fabric Evaluation
primaryPurpose: Synthesize fabric vocabulary, size ratings, and fit adjectives in a written customer review on a local clothing website.
communicativeOutcome: Write a 4-sentence clothing review assessing material softness, true-to-size fit, and color fidelity.
readingObjective: Read customer reviews on a Mongolian e-commerce boutique assessing fabric shrinkage and color fading.
writingObjective: Draft a written customer review stating garment size, material quality, and fit verdict.
pragmaticTarget: Providing helpful, balanced consumer feedback on fit and fabric quality.
reviewReason: Applies descriptive adjective syntax to contemporary online consumer culture.
audioPurpose: Audio read-back of written reviews.
successCriteria: Composes a coherent review detailing fabric composition, size accuracy, and comfort
Uses qualitative fit vocabulary (таарсан, хэт бариу, зөөлөн) without error
masteryEvidence: Writes 'Энэ ноолууран цамц маш зөөлөн, биед эвтэйхэн байна. Размер нь яг таарлаа' accurately.

title: One's Own Belongings: The Reflexive Suffix (-аа/-ээ/-оо/-өө)
primaryPurpose: Introduce the core reflexive-possessive suffix (-аа4) indicating that the possessed noun belongs to the grammatical subject of the clause.
communicativeOutcome: Distinguish between one's own possessions and another person's possessions (e.g. 'Би дээлээ өмслөө' vs 'Би түүний дээлийг өмслөө').
readingObjective: Read narrative sentences distinguishing subject-owned items from third-party items.
listeningObjective: Identify the reflexive suffix (-аа4) in spoken accounts of dressing and preparing personal belongings.
writingObjective: Transform 4 sentences replacing genitive pronouns ('миний ном') with the reflexive-possessive suffix ('номоо').
spokenProductionObjective: Explain personal actions: 'Би малгайгаа өмсөөд, цүнхээ авлаа'.
pragmaticTarget: Using reflexive possession naturally to avoid unnatural repetitive genitive pronouns ('миний', 'чиний').
reviewReason: Transforms analytical genitive possession (миний X) into synthetic reflexive possession (X-аа).
audioPurpose: Model quadruple vowel harmony (-аа, -ээ, -оо, -өө) and long vowel acoustic quality.
successCriteria: Selects correct reflexive allomorph according to root vowel harmony
Uses reflexive suffix when object belongs to clause subject
masteryEvidence: Correctly converts 'Би миний дээлийг авлаа' to 'Би дээлээ авлаа' consistently.

title: Dressing Up: Wardrobe Items & Daily Dressing Routines
primaryPurpose: Introduce expanded wardrobe vocabulary (бүс, ороолт, бээлий, оймс, хүрэм, гутал) paired with specialized dressing verbs (өмсөх, бүслэх, зүүх, углах).
communicativeOutcome: Describe getting dressed for different weather conditions using reflexive possession on each article of clothing.
readingObjective: Read a weather advisory instructing citizens how to bundle up for -30°C winter temperatures.
listeningObjective: Understand parent instructing child to put on hat, scarf, and mittens before leaving.
writingObjective: Write a 4-sentence daily morning dressing checklist using reflexive nouns.
spokenProductionObjective: Describe your winter outfit: 'Би дулаан хүрэм өмсөж, ороолтоо зүүж, бээлийгээ өмсөнө'.
registerTarget: Everyday personal and family routine register
pragmaticTarget: Selecting culturally accurate dressing verbs (өмсөх for garments, зүүх for scarves/jewelry/watches, бүслэх for sashes).
reviewReason: Links habitual daily routines (-даг) with reflexive wardrobe dressing.
audioPurpose: Pronounce paired clothing items and corresponding dressing verbs.
successCriteria: Applies appropriate verb for each accessory: малгайгаа өмсөх, ороолтоо зүүх, бүсээ бүслэх
Marks all possessed clothing items with reflexive-possessive suffix
masteryEvidence: Accurately matches 6 clothing articles with their specific dressing verbs and adds reflexive endings.

title: Deciphering Personal Narrative Letters & Reflexive-Possessive Diary Entries
primaryPurpose: Analyze personal journal entries and letters employing reflexive possessive suffixes (-аа4).
communicativeOutcome: Discuss what you and your family are wearing for a major holiday (Tsagaan Sar or Naadam) using reflexive forms.
readingObjective: Identify self-referential possession ('өөрийнхөө гэр бүл', 'ахдаа') in written Cyrillic narratives.
listeningObjective: Follow a family member's description of tailoring new silk deels for the coming celebration.
spokenProductionObjective: Describe festival preparation: 'Би энэ Цагаан сараар цэнхэр торгон дээлээ өмсөж, шар бүсээ бүслэнэ'.
pragmaticTarget: Appreciating the cultural pride associated with wearing finely coordinated national costume.
reviewReason: Combines prospective and volitional intentions with traditional holiday wear.
audioPurpose: Authentic conversational tone of family holiday preparations.
successCriteria: Accurately describes traditional festival attire using reflexive suffixes
Distinguishes between subject's own deel (дээлээ) and another person's deel (дээлийг нь)
masteryEvidence: Engages in a 4-turn dialogue describing personal festival outfit and family accessories.

title: Acoustic Lab: Parsing Reflexive Pronouns in Narrative Monologues
primaryPurpose: Develop focused auditory discrimination between reflexive-possessive nouns (-аа4) and non-reflexive accusative/genitive nouns in narrative speech.
communicativeOutcome: Distinguish whether an actor in a narrative is taking their own belongings or someone else's belongings based solely on auditory case morphology.
listeningObjective: Determine possession ownership (own vs another's) across 6 audio sentence pairs (e.g. 'Машинаа уналаа' vs 'Машиныг нь уналаа').
spokenProductionObjective: Explain to a peer who owned the item in each audio clip.
pragmaticTarget: Auditory precision in identifying crucial possessive grammatical distinctions.
reviewReason: Sharpens phonological discrimination between accusative (-ыг/-ийг) and reflexive (-аа4).
audioPurpose: Provide high-clarity native speech contrasting minimal pairs in possessive endings.
successCriteria: Achieves 100% accuracy distinguishing reflexive -аа from third-person -ийг нь in audio pairs
Correctly identifies the owner of lost or exchanged items in short audio stories
masteryEvidence: Accurately categorizes 6 audio sentences into 'subject's own property' vs 'other person's property'.

title: Festive Wardrobe: Writing an Account of Personal Holiday Attire
primaryPurpose: Synthesize reflexive-possessive morphology, clothing terminology, and colors in a coherent personal written description.
communicativeOutcome: Compose a 5-6 sentence descriptive paragraph explaining your holiday attire, boots, accessories, and preparation routine.
readingObjective: Read a peer's festival attire essay to check for correct reflexive suffixation.
writingObjective: Draft a 6-sentence paragraph describing your festival clothing using at least 4 reflexive-possessive nouns.

reviewReason: Utilizes sequential converb clauses (-аад) to structure the sequence of dressing up.
audioPurpose: Read back written personal essay for grammatical auditing.
successCriteria: Writes a coherent paragraph with at least 4 correctly formed reflexive-possessive nouns
Accurately pairs garments with appropriate dressing verbs (өмсөх, зүүх, бүслэх)
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Би баяраар шинэ дээлээ өмсөж, тоногтой мөнгөн бүсээ бүслээд, монгол гутлаа өмсөнө' flawlessly.

title: Fused Suffixes: Combining Cases with Reflexive Possession
primaryPurpose: Introduce the synthetic fusion of case suffixes with the reflexive-possessive morpheme: Ablative (-аасаа4), Dative-Locative (-даа4), Instrumental (-аараа4), and Comitative (-тайгаа4).
communicativeOutcome: Express actions originating from, located at, or done with one's own people and possessions (e.g. 'Гэрээсээ гарлаа', 'Ахтайгаа уулзлаа', 'Машинаараа явлаа').
readingObjective: Read personal journal entries highlighting reflexive case combinations.
listeningObjective: Identify fused reflexive case endings in conversational speech.
writingObjective: Combine 4 root nouns with ablative-reflexive, comitative-reflexive, and instrumental-reflexive suffixes.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain personal movements: 'Би гэрээсээ гараад, найзтайгаа хамт сургууль руугаа явлаа'.
registerTarget: Standard everyday conversational and narrative register
pragmaticTarget: Using synthetic fused case-reflexive endings effortlessly in continuous speech.
reviewReason: Fuses previously mastered A1 independent case suffixes with the A2 reflexive system.
audioPurpose: Demonstrate phonological fusion and long vowel duration in fused case-reflexive endings.
successCriteria: Correctly selects fused form: -аасаа (from own), -даа (at/to own), -аараа (by own), -тайгаа (with own)
Respects root vowel harmony across all four cases
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Би өөрийнхөө машинаараа найзынхаа гэр рүү явлаа' without morphological error.

title: With My Family & Friends: The Comitative Reflexive (-тайгаа4)
primaryPurpose: Master the comitative reflexive suffix (-тайгаа4 / -тойгоо / -тэйгээ / -төөгөө) in social contexts: spending time with one's spouse, children, colleagues, and siblings.
communicativeOutcome: Describe social gatherings and family leisure activities with one's own companions (e.g. 'Гэр бүлийнхэнтэйгээ амарлаа', 'Хүүхдүүдтэйгээ тоглолоо').
readingObjective: Read social media posts describing weekend outings with one's relatives and peers.
listeningObjective: Understand friends recounting weekend trips taken with their respective families.
writingObjective: List 4 weekend activities performed together with your own family members.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain weekend plans: 'Би амралтын өдрөөр аав ээжтэйгээ хөдөө явна'.
pragmaticTarget: Expressing affectionate familial closeness naturally through comitative-reflexive marking.
reviewReason: Expands simple comitative companion phrases into reflexive family togetherness.
audioPurpose: Model comitative reflexive vowel harmony combinations.
successCriteria: Selects correct vowel harmony allomorph (-тайгаа, -тэйгээ, -тойгоо, -төөгөө)
Expresses shared activities with family without redundant possessive pronouns
masteryEvidence: Utters 'Би дүүтэйгээ хамт кино үзсэн' with fluent pronunciation and correct suffixation.

title: Acoustic Lab: Discriminating Case-Reflexive Fusions in Fast Speech
primaryPurpose: Develop acoustic listening comprehension of fast conversational contractions of case-reflexive fusions (-аасаа, -даа, -аараа, -тайгаа) in rapid speech.
communicativeOutcome: Correctly identify originating place (-аасаа), destination/location (-даа), instrument (-аараа), or companion (-тайгаа) from rapid spoken clips.
listeningObjective: Identify specific case-reflexive suffix across 8 rapid speech audio items and match with semantic role.
spokenProductionObjective: Repeat overheard case-reflexive phrases with accurate vowel harmony.
pragmaticTarget: Parsing reduced case-reflexive vowels in unscripted colloquial exchanges.
reviewReason: Tests auditory comprehension of complex fused ablative endings.
audioPurpose: Provide natural native conversational clips with fast elision of case endings.
successCriteria: Correctly classifies auditory stimuli into ablative (-аасаа), dative (-даа), instrumental (-аараа), or comitative (-тайгаа)
Differentiates 'гэртээ' (at/to own home) from 'гэрээсээ' (from own home) without hesitation
masteryEvidence: Achieves 100% accuracy on an 8-item rapid speech case-reflexive discrimination quiz.

title: Deciphering Personal Letters: Family Chronicles & Homecoming
primaryPurpose: Develop reading comprehension for personal correspondence, family emails, and travel memoirs rich in case-reflexive structures.

primaryPurpose: Develop spoken conversational fluency during family gatherings, discussing travel from one's hometown, visiting siblings, and shared projects.

Answers kinship questions accurately without hesitation

title: Homecoming Memoir: Writing Personal Travel Chronology
primaryPurpose: Consolidate all four reflexive case combinations (-аасаа, -даа, -аараа, -тайгаа) into an extended written autobiographical reflection.

writingObjective: Draft a 6-8 sentence memoir including ablative-reflexive, dative-reflexive, instrumental-reflexive, and comitative-reflexive structures.

masteryEvidence: Drafts 'Би зун нутгаасаа гараад, дүүтэйгээ машинаараа явж, ээжийнхээ гэртээ очсон...' flawlessly.

title: Its Price & Its Quality: The Third-Person Enclitic 'нь'
primaryPurpose: Introduce the unstressed third-person possessive enclitic particle 'нь' marking third-person possession ('its/his/her/their') and functioning as an informational topic marker.
communicativeOutcome: Describe attributes of products and places using 'нь' (e.g. 'Үнэ нь боломжийн, чанар нь сайн', 'Өнгө нь гоё юм').
readingObjective: Read consumer reviews highlighting product attributes marked with the enclitic 'нь'.
listeningObjective: Identify 'нь' functioning as a topic marker in product reviews and retail advice.
writingObjective: Write 3 sentences evaluating products using 'X нь Y' topic-comment structure.
spokenProductionObjective: Evaluate an item: 'Энэ цамцны өнгө нь гоё боловч, үнэ нь арай өндөр байна'.
pragmaticTarget: Using 'нь' to soften statements and present topic-comment evaluations naturally.
reviewReason: Expands nominal possession from genitive case into third-person enclitic topic marking.
audioPurpose: Model prosodic integration of clitic 'нь' without vowel elongation.
successCriteria: Places 'нь' correctly following nominal head without attaching it as a bound suffix
Constructs well-formed topic-comment evaluations of products
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Энэ дэлгүүрийн бараа нь чанартай боловч үнэ нь үнэтэй' correctly.

title: Store Consultation: Asking About Origin, Warranty & Performance
primaryPurpose: Develop spoken communicative fluency for consulting with store specialists, asking about warranty terms (баталгаат хугацаа), origin, and accessories.
communicativeOutcome: Conduct a product consultation with a retail specialist: ask about warranty duration, where the product was made, and whether spare parts are available.
listeningObjective: Understand specialist explaining warranty terms: 'Баталгаат хугацаа нь нэг жил, гэхдээ засвар нь үнэгүй'.
spokenProductionObjective: Ask specialist: 'Энэ төхөөрөмжийн баталгаа нь хэдэн сар байдаг вэ? Сэлбэг нь олдоцтой юу?'.
